faq.domanda: What are the advantages of DTF printing for clothing?
faq.risposta: DTF (Direct to Film) technology lets us print high-resolution images directly onto fabric, delivering vivid colour and excellent durability over time. Ideal for t-shirts and promotional clothing, it withstands frequent washing and keeps its colours bright even after repeated use.

Heat-transfer personalisation involves applying heat-adhesive films directly onto the garments. It is a very versatile technique, suited to logos, names and simple graphics, and perfect for creating eye-catching designs on many types of fabric. This solution is hard-wearing and ideal for garments that need a simpler, more direct personalisation.

faq.domanda: When is embroidery the right choice for custom clothing?
faq.risposta: Embroidery is an elegant and long-lasting choice, particularly suited to corporate clothing and uniforms. It works well on heavier fabrics such as hoodies and caps, and gives a professional, high-quality look that enhances your brand in formal settings.

faq.domanda: How much does a custom t-shirt cost?
faq.risposta: A single t-shirt, 100% cotton included, starts from CHF 24.90 + VAT with a front print; add CHF 10.00 for a front-and-back print. For orders of 10 pieces, with front-and-back print, the price drops to around CHF 25.00 + VAT per item. The final price depends on the size of the prints: we set it to the exact franc in your free quote.

We offer personalisation for a wide range of garments: t-shirts, polos, hoodies, jackets, caps and workwear. Every type of garment can be personalised with different techniques depending on your preference and your brand's needs.

faq.domanda: How long does a custom clothing order take?
faq.risposta: Production times depend on the order volume and the complexity of the design. Generally, for small orders, the turnaround is around a couple of days. Get in touch for an estimated delivery time for your project.

faq.domanda: Which personalisation techniques are most wash-resistant?
faq.risposta: Embroidery is the most hard-wearing and long-lasting technique, ideal for garments that need to withstand frequent washing. DTF printing also offers good durability, especially when the garment is washed according to the instructions provided.
